units.title: Measurement uncertainty and propagation through an inference

required_components.description: Specify the measurand and measurement equation; distinguish error, correction and uncertainty.
required_components.success_condition: Give an explicit quantity, units, input roles and uncertain corrections.
required_components.failure_condition: Treat uncertainty as an observed error or the standard deviation as every source of uncertainty.

required_components.description: Derive covariance propagation and state the first-order boundary.
required_components.success_condition: Derive u²(y)=JΣJᵀ under its approximation conditions and retain covariance terms.
required_components.failure_condition: Use the independent-input formula for shared calibration errors or declare the Taylor approximation exact.

required_components.description: Separate Type A/Type B evaluations from random/systematic error terminology.
required_components.success_condition: Explain each information source and attach its uncertainty evaluation to the same model.
required_components.failure_condition: Call Type B subjective error without an assigned information model or equate the two classifications.

required_components.description: Explain coverage factors and nonlinear failure.
required_components.success_condition: Show why a quoted coverage factor needs conditions and supply a nonlinear countercase.
required_components.failure_condition: Treat k=2 as universally exact 95% coverage or ignore a zero-gradient failure.

units.title: Dimensional and scaling constraints on quantitative claims

required_components.description: Construct dimensionless products as a linear nullspace problem.
required_components.success_condition: Solve a dimension matrix and explain the rank-dependent count of independent products.
required_components.failure_condition: Subtract the number of written dimension names without checking rank.

required_components.description: Use proportional reasoning to separate exponents from constants.
required_components.success_condition: Derive an admissible exponent relation and identify what remains empirically undetermined.
required_components.failure_condition: Present dimensional consistency as proof of the physical law.

required_components.description: Check units, conversions and scaling regimes.
required_components.success_condition: Detect a dimensionally invalid expression and state the fixed quantities in a scaling comparison.
required_components.failure_condition: Change units or variables silently, or extrapolate a regime-specific scaling law.

required_components.description: Work an estimate with explicit bounds on what it supports.
required_components.success_condition: Give one order-of-magnitude estimate with input ranges and an omitted-variable failure.
required_components.failure_condition: Report unearned digits or treat the estimate as a confidence interval.

units.title: Approximate conclusions, limiting regimes and explicit error

required_components.description: Distinguish identity, bound, asymptotic equivalence and heuristic estimate.
required_components.success_condition: State the relation used and its domain before drawing the output conclusion.
required_components.failure_condition: Use an asymptotic sign as an exact equality or an informal estimate as a proven interval.

required_components.description: Develop lumping and limiting-case reasoning in bounded examples.
required_components.success_condition: Reconstruct selected characteristic-value and two-regime cases with their assumptions.
required_components.failure_condition: Replace heterogeneous inputs by an average without testing the relevant nonlinearity.

required_components.description: Trace approximation error into a decision or sign conclusion.
required_components.success_condition: Prove that an explicit error interval leaves the selected comparison unchanged, or abstain if it overlaps the threshold.
required_components.failure_condition: Use a close approximate value to decide a sign smaller than the error.

required_components.description: Show a failure near a regime transition or cancellation.
required_components.success_condition: Exhibit a concrete input where the neglected term changes the conclusion.
required_components.failure_condition: Claim uniform validity from pointwise or asymptotic validity alone.
